name: Ishbi-benob
overview: Ishbi-benob is a male figure mentioned in the Bible as a descendant of Raphah, a term associated with giants. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him. His identity is primarily linked to his lineage from the giant Raphah.
namesAndTitles: The name Ishbi-benob appears only once in Scripture without any given meaning or title. There is no indication that his name was given by God, and no further significance is provided beyond its identification in 2 Samuel 21:16.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ishbi-benob as a son of Raphah, connecting him to the descendants known as giants. No other family relationships are detailed beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Ishbi-benob is significant in the biblical narrative as a representative of the descendants of Raphah, often understood as giants, which highlights the presence of formidable foes during the period of Israel's history.
